UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_Tooltip: Shows the skill list in its own resizable window.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the skills window.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_HideTab: Hide skills tab in character info
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_HideTab_Tooltip: Removes the Skills tab from the Info/Health/Protection window. The vanilla skills key then opens the skills window instead.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F07_Tooltip: In the add-ingredient menu (soup, salad, etc.), the same ingredient is listed once and the one with the least left is used first.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F04_Tooltip: While reading, shows under the character how long until the book is finished. Game time is shown in orange, real time in green.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Tooltip: Right-click an item to add it to your wishlist; it is then highlighted in the inventory and loot windows. The list is saved on this PC only, not in the world.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the wishlist.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Empty: Right-click an item to add it
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_UseShared_Toolti: Uses a wishlist shared by everyone on the server. Anyone can add or remove items; they are shown in light blue.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F10_Tooltip: Hides the PvP (skull) button on the left and keeps PvP off. The button and the key no longer toggle it.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F12_Tooltip: Right-click an item in the inventory or loot window and choose Show recipes to open the crafting window filtered to the recipes that make it.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F09_Tooltip: Lists the players online on the server and those who were online in the last 7 days. Multiplayer only.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F09_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F09_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the player list.
